channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sam Presti | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sam Presti from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Sam Presti
item.description:
Justin Martinez:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on trusting Sam Presti to make the right decisions this summer:

“I don't have the time or energy to do Sam's job in my everyday life. Basketball takes up a lot. You can't wear every hat in every relationship. I can't go home and be the wife of the house and the kid of the house. I just can't do that. I've got to wear my dad hat. It's the same thing when I come to work. I wear the Shai hat. Sam wears the Sam hat. Mark wears the Mark hat. Chet wears the Chet hat. We all do our part to make our family in the building whole and running on all cylinders. That's how we've operated, and that's how we're going to continue.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Sam Presti, May 31, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Isaiah Hartenstein on Sam Presti
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Isaiah Hartenstein on signing with OKC:

“When Sam Presti came to Eugene, Oregon, that was the first thing he said, ‘I can't promise you minutes, I can't promise you your role, but I can promise you a culture.’”

Isaiah Hartenstein on Sam Presti, May 21, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on LeBron James, Sam Presti, James Harden, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I'm averaging 30 at 21 years old. Russell [Westbrook] was 22 years old as an All-Star, James [Harden] Sixth Man at 22, so we exceeded the timeline, so they wasn't ready for that. That's just my theory. I don't know exactly what Sam [Presti] was thinking or the owner, but my theory is that I don't think they were ready exactly for us to be contenders every year.”

Kevin Durant on LeBron James, Sam Presti, James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Jul 1, 2025. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Sam Presti
item.description:
“You can't just pull one of the key figures off the team and expect us to continue what we was doing. So I think they were kind of shocked at how fast, how good we got so fast and sometimes you get confused. On top of that, Sam Presti was probably what, 30-something years old? He was young. Everybody was young, trying to figure stuff out, trying to understand what this landscape was.”

Kevin Durant on Sam Presti, Jul 1, 2025. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Sam Presti, Brian Windhorst
item.description:
“And the question of like, ‘Why would he do that?’ The reason that Sam Presti kicked the tires on hiring Brian Windhorst from ESPN is that information to Sam Presti is currency. It is an edge, a competitive advantage. And you don’t surrender that information.”

Pablo Torre on Sam Presti, Brian Windhorst, Jun 12, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Sam Presti
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on his relationship with Sam Presti:

“Sam has always been honest with me from day one. You don’t get that that often.. He’s been that and I’ve tried to be the same back to him. Just two guys who trust each other and have one common goal.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Sam Presti, Jun 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Sam Presti, Clay Bennett
item.description:
Gilgeous-Alexander said about his quest to win a title.

“It’s not even about anything else. From the owner to the GM to the coach, everybody wants to win. And that’s all that matters. “I’m no different. (Thunder owner) Clay Bennett wants to win. (Thunder general manager) Sam Presti wants to win. They want to do everything in their power to help this team win. And that’s all I try to do.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Sam Presti, Clay Bennett, May 12, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Sam Presti
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Chet Holmgren on Sam Presti:

“This motherf***** is so light years ahead of where I am. I don’t even think or worry about what he’s doing. I’m like, ‘he’s gonna get this sh*t right.. let me get my sh*t right.”

Chet Holmgren on Sam Presti, Jul 18, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dillon Jones on Sam Presti
item.description:
Dillon Jones on Sam Presti:

“I think he’s the best person at his position in the NBA.”

Dillon Jones on Sam Presti, Jun 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Sam Presti, Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward's playoff experiences:

“We don't need a chaperone. These guys are on their own two feet. Our players are great, young professionals... (Presti's) been very selective about who we're bringing in the door and making sure that they're an organizational fit, that they'll be a fit in the locker room and that they'll be a stylistic fit. And he was a guy that Sam felt strongly checked all three of those boxes.”

Mark Daigneault on Sam Presti, Gordon Hayward, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mike Brown on RC Buford, Sam Presti
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“The first time I saw him play was when our front office, led by R.C. Buford, had us work him out at the pre-draft camp in Chicago [in 2001]. I thought he was just okay. He was fast, obviously. That stood out. But he really couldn’t shoot the ball well. He didn’t have a medium game. We had put him in through some drills, and we just didn’t know what he would bring to the table. After that first workout, the coaching staff wasn’t really that high on him. We liked him, but he didn’t have a great workout. RC Buford and Sam Presti were the ones that convinced all of us to take a second look at him.”

Mike Brown on RC Buford, Sam Presti, Aug 9, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Sam Presti
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Josh Giddey:

“When I retire, I want to be a GM or an owner of a team.“Asked what he would do as GM of the Thunder this summer, Josh laughed: “You leave that to Sam Presti, he’s the best in the business.”

Josh Giddey on Sam Presti, Apr 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Sam Presti
item.description:
Rylan Stiles:Jalen Williams on his OKC workout

“It was dope. Going in there and picking [Sam Presti’s brain] it was cool he was in there with us for the workout. It was really hot and humid out there in Oklahoma that was a change…the humidity that was an adjustment.”

Jalen Williams on Sam Presti, Jun 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @Rylan_Stiles.

item.title: Jabari Smith Jr on Sam Presti
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Jabari Smith Jr on meeting with OKC and Sam Presti:

“It was great meeting him. He's a great guy. The visit was great. Got to meet the staff, the coaches. The overall visit was just amazing.”

Jabari Smith Jr on Sam Presti, Jun 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey
item.description:
“Josh Giddey is great. Sam Presti, I don’t understand this guy’s eye for talent. He drafted KD, Russ [Westbrook], Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey and the list goes on and on and on. This guy is pretty damn good.”

LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey, Feb 20, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Sam Presti
item.description:
Rylan Stiles:Mark Daigneault on the deadline

“[Sam Presti] has done this a long time he has a great balance with me of being informative where I’m not in the dark, without giving me the play by play,that’s not my job. If something gets close he will make me aware. I’m focused on the team.”

Mark Daigneault on Sam Presti, Feb 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @Rylan_Stiles.

item.title: George Hill on Sam Presti
item.description:
George Hill on OKC’s chemistry:

“You have to give praise to the front office here. Sam Presti brings in high character guys. Coach has done drills where we have to talk about who we are as a person.”

George Hill on Sam Presti, Dec 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Paul George on Sam Presti, Clay Bennett
item.description:
Paul George:

“First and foremost, I just want to thank the whole Thunder organization, Mr. Bennett, Sam Presti for the partnership we had there. It was a great two years we had there, but ultimately they helped me find my way back home to L.A. and I’m appreciative for that.”

Paul George on Sam Presti, Clay Bennett, Jul 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Sam Presti, Troy Weaver, Russell Westbrook, Clay Bennett
item.description:
“No matter if they talk to me or they're mad at me. Whether it's Sam Presti or Troy Weaver or Russell Westbrook or Nick Collison. Whether it's Wilson Taylor or Clay Bennett and his family, I love them from the bottom of my heart. We're not talking, but eventually we will.”

Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Sam Presti, Troy Weaver, Russell Westbrook, Clay Bennett, Nov 16, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Sam Presti
item.description:
Fred Katz:Westbrook on Presti:

“He's done an amazing job. He's done a great job ever since I've been here. He's finding ways to make us a great team.”

Russell Westbrook on Sam Presti, Sep 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Josh Huestis on Sam Presti, Paul George
item.description:
Fred Katz‏:Josh Huestis on how he found out about the Paul George trade:

“I thought it was a joke at first, because Sam Presti works in silence.”

Josh Huestis on Sam Presti, Paul George, Jul 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Sam Presti, Clay Bennett
item.description:
“(Thunder GM) Sam Presti’s a friend of mine. I know (Thunder owner) Clay Bennett. It’s a class organization all the way,so I don’t really pay any attention to a story like that unless there’s an actual name name that’s put on it. I assume it’s just sources. Is it ‘sources’? I don’t know who that is. It’s nobody with the Warriors. We have great respect for them. Sam’s been a friend of mine forever. They’re first-class, so I don’t know where that comes from.”

Steve Kerr on Sam Presti, Clay Bennett, Mar 20, 2017. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Serge Ibaka on Sam Presti
item.description:
Serge Ibaka on being traded by the Thunder:

“Atfirst I was surprised, but then I thought 'OK, [GM Sam Presti] doesn't really believe in me no more. So that was the time for me to move on.”

Serge Ibaka on Sam Presti, Mar 3, 2017. Source: The Vertical.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Sam Presti
item.description:
“I am extremely thankful the way [Thunder general manager Sam Presti] laid out the organization to me over about a two-and-a-half-day periodbecause, to be honest with you, I really did not know a lot about the Oklahoma City Thunder. I knew of Sam, I obviously knew of the players and organization, but I didn't know what it was about. And it was that -- that really made me turn my head when I started to find out more, that I think the qualities, the values, what this organization is about is directly in line and mirrors what I believe.”

Billy Donovan on Sam Presti, May 2, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Sam Presti
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:Durant on Sam Presti:

“Our community is blessed to have you. Our team is blessed to have you.”

Kevin Durant on Sam Presti, May 6, 2014. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Tibor Pleiss on Sam Presti
item.description:
Recently, on his blog, the German center announced his intention to return to the Euroleague to play out the second season of his four-year contract with Caja Laboral.

“I am in contact with Thunder GM Sam Presti and I often speak on phone with Jonny Rogers, who lives in Barcelona and he is a scout for the Thunder in Europe,”

Tibor Pleiss on Sam Presti, Jul 8, 2013. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Sam Presti
item.description:
Chris Mannix:Manu Ginobili:

“We know Sam Presti, he's a sharp guy. He built this out of nothing.”

Manu Ginobili on Sam Presti, Jun 7, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Sam Presti
item.description:
“But to be honest, once they got rid of P.J., I didn't know he would be the interim coach. I didn't know they'd bring him in as a coach. But once they did, the concepts and the identity that he tried to bring to this organization was something I believed in, and I knew it was going to be good for our organzation. I always, since Day One, I believed in Sam Presti and the guys in our organization.”

Kevin Durant on Sam Presti, Jan 23, 2012. Source: NBA.com.
